description: 協助中油公司推動國內第三座液化天然氣接收站投資計畫之摘要 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部. 經濟部為因應政府宣布核四停工及封存，預期未來國內基載電力容量將下降，若以增加燃氣電廠做為因應，天然氣需求勢必大幅增加。 為確保國內供電及供氣穩定，及時完成第三座天然氣接收站之興建實屬刻不容緩。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
